Layered upper design: Contrasting quarter, toe and heel sections give the low-top shoe a clear panelled silhouette.

Adjustable lace opening: The front eyelet row and laces sit above a closed tongue, with the actual opening shown in the close-up photograph.

Wraparound toe overlay: A darker overlay follows the front edge of the rounded toe and meets the raised sole band.

Distinct sole edge: Recessed lines and contrasting heel sections create a segmented appearance along the sidewall; the original underside view shows the bottom layout.

Three colour combinations: White/Grey, Beige/Navy and Black/Orange are listed in EU39-48 for wholesale assortments.
